Content.zh:
大家好！

又有更新日志啦！

<size=150%>版本 EA_0.28：</size>

- 修复了更多动物能交易的bug！
- 修复了跳过教程不会解锁教程对应的蓝图的bug。
- 衬衫和织布机现在具有相同的研究要求。
- 青蛙不再算作鱼类。
- 松针现在可以用作垫料。
- 再也无法从南向北进入瀑布洞穴。
- 移除了生长在错误位置的柳树。
- 现在可以在隐秘林地中建造地窖。
- 为爬树事件添加了美术。

目前就这些。
下次见！
Content.en:
Hello everyone!

Patch Notes again!

<size=150%>Version EA_0.28:</size>

- Fixed more of the trader animals bugs!
- Fixed a bug where skipping the tutorial would not unlock the tutorial blueprints.
- Shirt cloth and loom now have the same research requirements.
- Frogs no longer count as fish.
- Pine Needles can now be used as bedding material.
- You can no longer enter the waterfall cave by going north.
- Removed willows that were growing in incorrect locations.
- Cellars can now be built in the secret grove.
- Added art for the tree climbing event.

That's all for now. 
See you next time!
